items.title: Inside the AI Training Data Market — Gabe Greenberg, G2i
items.summary: A frontier lab can pay more for training data it gets to keep exclusive, or take a discount on data another lab can buy too. At AI Engineer CODE, G2i founder Gabe Greenberg tells swyx how labs make that decision, how small pilot orders turn into bigger engagements, and when it makes sense to build a data operation in-house. We also get into what the labs are buying. A good training task should sit just ahead of what
items.summaryZh: AI 训练数据市场内部 — Gabe Greenberg，G2i。前沿实验室可以支付更多费用来购买其专有的训练数据，或者对其他实验室也可以购买的数据享受折扣。在 AI Engineer CODE 中，G2i 创始人 Gabe Greenberg 向 swyx 讲述了实验室如何做出这一决定、小额试点订单如何变成更大的合作，以及何时需要在内部构建数据操作。

items.title: Astra 6.2’s Brain Gets Smart But Its Head Gets Dumb
items.summary: Astra 6.2 has very high intelligence. Astra 6.2 has very low wisdom. Astra will solve extremely hard problems, and also find the problem of ‘what did the user want me to do’ extremely hard. We thought those days were behind us, and yet it seems that they are back.
